quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the artisanal cheese producer's marketing materials emphasize an unbroken multi-generational family tradition dating back over a century as the foundation of its authenticity, a business history compiled for an industry trade publication, drawing on records the family itself provided, revealed production was suspended entirely for nearly two decades during wartime disruption.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the family tradition in the marketing.
quests.explanation: The passage says an unbroken tradition, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The software company's frequently cited statistic that its customer support chatbot successfully resolves a specific, prominently advertised percentage of inquiries without human escalation is calculated using a definition of successful resolution that counts any conversation without an explicit human request as successful, regardless of whether the issue was actually addressed.
quests.hint: Find what the chatbot resolves inquiries without.
quests.explanation: The passage says without human escalation, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the pharmaceutical company's promotional materials for its new medication emphasize a specific, favorable rate of symptom improvement observed in clinical trials, the same trial data shows a comparably high rate of improvement in the placebo group as well, a detail present in the full regulatory filing but far less prominent in consumer marketing.
quests.hint: Find what group also showed a comparably high improvement rate.
quests.explanation: The passage says the placebo group, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The music festival's frequently repeated claim of having sold out within minutes for six consecutive years, a statistic prominently featured in its marketing to justify continually rising ticket prices, was complicated by resale market data showing that in at least two of those years, tickets remained available through official channels well beyond the initial minutes.
quests.hint: Find what type of market data complicated the claim.
quests.explanation: The passage says resale market data, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although migratory eel populations were long assumed by fisheries scientists to complete their entire life cycle within a single, well-defined river system, satellite and genetic tracking conducted over the past two decades has revealed that individuals from ostensibly distinct river populations converge to spawn in a shared oceanic region before dispersing widely.
quests.hint: Find what eels from different rivers do to spawn together.
quests.explanation: The passage says they converge to spawn, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The neighborhood association's frequently repeated claim that its community policing initiative alone produced the substantial, multi-year decline in reported property crime in the district, a claim featured prominently in grant applications, is complicated by city-wide crime statistics showing a comparably sized decline across several other districts entirely without any equivalent initiative.
quests.hint: Find the word describing how the decline compared across other districts.
quests.explanation: The passage says a comparably sized decline, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The oft-repeated claim that Tomas overhauled his entire diet overnight after a single alarming doctor's visit makes for a tidier narrative than what his own records actually show, which is a considerably more gradual process spanning nearly eight months, during which he eliminated one category of food every few weeks.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the type of process Tomas actually went through.
quests.explanation: The passage describes it as a gradual process, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although it is frequently assumed, including by several of the district's own veteran teachers, that the marked improvement in standardized reading scores following the curriculum change must be attributable to the new curriculum itself, a careful comparison controlling for a simultaneous reduction in average class size found that factor equally significant.
quests.hint: Find what teachers assumed the score improvement was due to.
quests.explanation: The passage says attributable to the curriculum, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The widely circulated account of the startup's rapid early growth, in which its founders describe achieving product-market fit within their first three months based almost entirely on organic word of mouth, omits a detail confirmed in the company's own later funding documents about a substantial early paid marketing budget.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the word of mouth the founders credited.
quests.explanation: The passage says organic word of mouth, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the cruise line's promotional materials describe its onboard water reclamation system as achieving a specific, frequently quoted percentage of freshwater self-sufficiency per voyage, an independent environmental audit commissioned by a maritime regulatory body found this figure was calculated using an idealized operating scenario rarely matched under actual voyage conditions.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the operating scenario used in the calculation.
quests.explanation: The passage says an idealized scenario, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The family's longstanding account of Aunt Rosa's supposedly instant and effortless adjustment to life in a new country, a story often invoked to encourage other relatives facing similar transitions, was substantially revised after her own diaries from that period surfaced, revealing homesickness she deliberately kept hidden from the wider family.
quests.hint: Find how Aunt Rosa kept her homesickness hidden.
quests.explanation: The passage says deliberately kept hidden, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the appliance manufacturer's warranty terms are marketed as providing comprehensive coverage for manufacturing defects over a five-year period, a class-action lawsuit's discovery process revealed internal engineering documents acknowledging a known failure pattern the company had nonetheless classified as normal wear specifically to exclude it from warranty coverage.
quests.hint: Find what the company did to the failure pattern to avoid coverage.
quests.explanation: The passage says the company classified it, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The popular restaurant chain's frequently cited claim that its signature dish has remained identical to the original recipe served at its first location decades ago, a detail proudly featured on menus and in franchise materials, is complicated by discovery documents from an unrelated trademark dispute revealing several cost-driven reformulations as the chain scaled nationally.
quests.hint: Find the word describing how the dish is claimed to compare to the original.
quests.explanation: The passage says remained identical, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Tellingly, the cybersecurity firm's widely publicized claim that a particular strain of malware had been fully neutralized following its emergency patch release, a claim that generated considerable positive press at the time, was later revised in a far less publicized follow-up bulletin acknowledging a secondary infection method remained viable.
quests.hint: Find what the firm originally claimed had happened to the malware.
quests.explanation: The passage says fully neutralized, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The fitness chain's marketing claim that its signature high-intensity class program produces a specific average measurable improvement in cardiovascular fitness within a set number of weeks is based on an internal study whose methodology, disclosed only upon request, excluded participants who did not complete the entire program.
quests.hint: Find what part of the internal study excluded certain participants.
quests.explanation: The passage says the study's methodology, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the video streaming service's investor presentations have consistently emphasized subscriber growth as the primary indicator of the platform's overall health, a metric that has driven considerable positive market sentiment, a separate internal metric tracking engagement over time revealed a meaningful share of new subscribers had already canceled within ninety days.
quests.hint: Find what the separate internal metric tracked over time.
quests.explanation: The passage says tracking engagement, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The popular claim that a particular species of jellyfish is entirely immune to aging and cannot die of natural causes under any circumstances, a characterization that has circulated widely in popular media, somewhat overstates findings that are, in the actual scientific literature, considerably more narrow regarding its unusual regenerative capabilities under stress.
quests.hint: Find what type of capabilities the scientific literature actually describes.
quests.explanation: The passage says regenerative capabilities, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the town's tourism board has consistently credited its rebranding campaign, launched three years ago at considerable expense, with the subsequent increase in annual visitor spending, an economic impact study found a significant currency-driven affordability shift likely accounted for a substantial share of that increase instead.
quests.hint: Find what type of shift the economic study identified.
quests.explanation: The passage says an affordability shift, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: While it would be convenient to attribute the noticeable improvement in Elena's sleep quality entirely to the white noise machine she began using eight months ago, a device she has since recommended enthusiastically to nearly everyone she knows, her own account reveals the machine's introduction coincided with a separate and arguably more significant change in her living situation.
quests.hint: Find what the machine's introduction did with another life change.
quests.explanation: The passage says it coincided with the change, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The graduate program's frequently cited statistic that ninety percent of its alumni are employed in the field within six months of graduation, a figure prominently featured in recruitment materials, is calculated using a denominator that excludes any graduate who did not respond to the program's voluntary post-graduation survey.
quests.hint: Find what part of the calculation excludes non-respondents.
quests.explanation: The passage says the denominator excludes them, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the retail chain's corporate communications have consistently attributed this year's improved employee retention figures to a newly introduced flexible scheduling policy rolled out company-wide, an internal analysis segmenting retention data by store location found regions with an independent minimum wage increase showed considerably larger improvements.
quests.hint: Find what the internal analysis did to the retention data.
quests.explanation: The passage says segmenting data by location, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The mountain resort's frequently repeated claim that its ski season has remained consistently reliable for over four decades, a talking point featured prominently in its marketing to reassure prospective visitors, is complicated by the resort's own internal snowfall records, which show a measurable, statistically significant decline in natural snowfall over the past fifteen years specifically.
quests.hint: Find the word describing how significant the decline in snowfall was.
quests.explanation: The passage says statistically significant, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although Hassan's family has long attributed the eventual reconciliation between his parents after a lengthy separation to a single dramatic conversation that has since become something of a family legend, his mother's own account, shared candidly only in recent years, describes a much slower process involving an undisclosed therapist.
quests.hint: Find what the family attributed to a single dramatic conversation.
quests.explanation: The passage says the reconciliation, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The cosmetics brand's marketing claim that its best-selling serum was clinically proven to reduce the appearance of fine lines within a specific, frequently cited number of weeks was found by a regulatory review to be based on a single small-scale study funded directly by the brand itself, with no independent replication.
quests.hint: Find what the regulatory review found was missing from the study.
quests.explanation: The passage says no independent replication, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the specialty coffee company's marketing has long emphasized that its beans are sourced directly from a small number of named family farms, a claim central to its premium pricing, a supply chain audit found the company had, on several documented occasions, supplemented its supply through a regional broker without disclosing this substitution to consumers.
quests.hint: Find what the company did to its supply during shortfalls.
quests.explanation: The passage says it supplemented its supply, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Strikingly, although the wearable device manufacturer markets its sleep-tracking feature as clinically validated for accuracy, a comparison study conducted by university researchers using polysomnography, the clinical gold standard for sleep measurement, as a reference point found the device's accuracy was considerably weaker specifically for distinguishing between different sleep stages.
quests.hint: Find what clinical measurement method the comparison study used.
quests.explanation: The passage says polysomnography, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the mental health app's marketing describes its mood-tracking algorithm as capable of detecting early warning signs of depressive episodes with a specific, frequently cited accuracy rate, an independent evaluation found this accuracy held only for a minority of users who logged entries consistently on a near-daily basis.
quests.hint: Find what share of users the high accuracy rate actually applied to.
quests.explanation: The passage says only a minority, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The record label's widely circulated account of discovering its most commercially successful artist through a chance encounter at an open-mic night, a story that has become central to the label's own promotional identity, was revised considerably after industry trade documents surfaced showing the artist had been under formal consideration for months prior to that supposedly chance encounter.
quests.hint: Find what the trade documents showed the artist had been under.
quests.explanation: The passage says formal consideration, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although a particular species of migratory bat was long believed by wildlife researchers to travel in family groups that remain stable across an individual's lifetime, a belief supported mainly by observational data limited to breeding season, more recent tracking studies have found that group composition during the non-breeding period is considerably more fluid.
quests.hint: Find the word describing group composition according to recent tracking.
quests.explanation: The passage says considerably more fluid, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: The public library system's widely cited statistic that program attendance increased dramatically following its recent renovation, a figure referenced in its most recent funding request, is calculated by comparing an unusually eventful reopening month against a typical prior month, a comparison the system's own footnote acknowledges is not representative.
quests.hint: Find what the footnote says the comparison is not.
quests.explanation: The passage says not representative, so that is correct.
